caption: The drawing depicts a cast iron balcony railing consisting of a repetitive vertical pattern of ornate ironwork. Each vertical section includes a central arched shape with curling, decorative elements on both sides and symmetrical lattice-like diamond shapes in the middle, embellished with additional scrollwork details. There are six main vertical sections visible, evenly spaced and joined at the top and bottom by horizontal rails. The bottom of the drawing shows a shaded, textured platform or balcony floor, rendered with diagonal hatching lines. Above the railing, the title "CAST IRON BALCONY RAILING" is handwritten in uppercase letters, centered near the top of the drawing. The background is plain, with only stylized, faint sketches of branches or vines in the upper left and right corners. The entire composition is set within a rectangular border, and the drawing is done in black ink on an off-white or beige paper. On the right border, the measurement "39’" is noted vertically.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
